opsAudit.intro: Every audit entry across the platform — customer teams, Track AI, system jobs, source keys and platform operators — with actor, action, organisation, target and redacted details. Search, filter, page and export; the log itself is append-only.

filters.actionHint: Exact action or prefix: “platform.organization” includes every action below it.
filters.platformOnlyHint: Entries whose actor is a platform operator (actor kind “platform”), regardless of organisation.
filters.exportHint: The same filters and the same redacted key lists as this table, newest first, at most {max} rows; every export is recorded in the audit log.

summary.unknownOrganization: No organisation has the ID or slug “{input}”; nothing matches until you correct it.

notes.retention: Entries are kept for {days} days by default; an organisation can set its own window for its audit log, and entries without an organisation follow the default. The retention job deletes older entries permanently, so an export is the only way to keep them longer.
notes.redacted: Values are redacted before they are stored and again before display; end-user personal data and secrets never appear here.
notes.appendOnly: The log is append-only: nothing here can be edited or deleted, and every CSV export is itself an entry.

table.caption: Audit entries with time, actor, action, organisation, target and redacted details

empty.title: No audit entries yet
empty.text: Entries appear as soon as someone acts on the platform: a sign-up, a configuration change, an operator action.
empty.filteredText: Loosen the filters, widen the date range or clear the search.
